tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis of business requirements in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Grundfos’ commitment to sustainable water solutions and its innovative digital strategy. With over five years of senior SAP Commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and scaled robust e-commerce platforms that drive global reach and operational excellence.

bullets.label: **Technical Leadership**
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions on Hybris 2211, leading backend and frontend development while ensuring high-performance Java/Spring architectures.

bullets.label: **API & Integration Expertise**
bullets.text: Created and maintained OCC REST services and complex PIM-to-ERP/MDM data pipelines, eliminating integration bottlenecks for international stakeholders.

bullets.label: **DevOps & Cloud Delivery**
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes for seamless cloud releases and rapid feature delivery.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: Collaborated with business owners to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs, and automated tests, supporting production stability and continuous improvement.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Grundfos.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Senior SAP Developer
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von Grundfos für nachhaltige Wasserlösungen und die digitale Innovationskraft begeistern mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Senior-Erfahrung in SAP Commerce bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich skalierbare E-Commerce-Plattformen entwickelt, die globale Prozesse optimieren.

bullets.label: **Technische Führung**
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen auf Hybris 2211, leitete Backend- und Frontend-Entwicklung mit leistungsstarken Java/Spring-Architekturen.

bullets.label: **API- und Integrationskompetenz**
bullets.text: Erstellte OCC-REST-Services und komplexe PIM-zu-ERP/MDM-Datenpipelines, wodurch Integrationsengpässe für internationale Teams beseitigt wurden.

bullets.label: **DevOps- und Cloud-Bereitstellung**
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 durch und nutzte Docker sowie Kubernetes für reibungslose Cloud-Rollouts und schnelle Feature-Lieferungen.

bullets.label: **Techno-funktionale Beratung**
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, übersetzte Anforderungen in User Stories, funktionale Spezifikationen und automatisierte Tests, um Produktionsstabilität zu sichern.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, Kündigungsfrist bis 15. Dezember 2026, Verfügbarkeit ab 16. Dezember 2026. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Grundfos zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Grundfos is a global leader in water technology, pioneering sustainable solutions that improve lives worldwide. Their focus on digital transformation aligns perfectly with my experience delivering high-performing SAP Commerce platforms that enable efficient, data-driven commerce. Joining Grundfos would let me apply my integration and cloud-deployment expertise to support their mission of making clean water accessible for all.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Grundfos accelerate its digital commerce, leveraging my SAP Commerce, integration and cloud-deployment expertise to drive sustainable growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my integration and cloud-deployment skills to Grundfos. Could we discuss the Senior SAP Developer role?
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Developer position. With over five years of senior SAP Commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to Grundfos.

Kind regards,
